# Skills Index (Canonical Map)

This file is the canonical discovery map for repository-local AI skills.
Canonical skill definitions live under `.github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
Claude Code redirect adapters are generated under `.claude/skills/`.

## Synchronization

After adding, renaming, removing, or materially changing a skill, instruction,
or prompt, regenerate Claude adapters:

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File ./sync_ai_assets.ps1
```

Do not edit files containing `Generated by sync_ai_assets.ps1` directly.

## External Discovery

Prefer the installed `find-skills` capability or the global Skills CLI when a
required capability is not present locally:

```bash
npx skills find <query>
npx skills list -g
npx skills add <owner/repo@skill> -g -y
npx skills check
```

The source repository's JFrog, SonarQube, private pipeline-catalog, Eden, and
FESTACK assets are intentionally not part of this public repository.
